function.description: Get a wallet's open Jupiter Lend Borrow positions — collateral supplied, debt owed, and residual dust debt (raw atomic units), per position. These amounts carry no decimals of their own: cross-reference solana.lend.borrowVaults by vaultId for each leg's symbol, decimals, and risk thresholds before interpreting or acting on them. Use a position's id as solana.lend.borrowOperate's positionId to adjust or close it. Covers collateralized Borrow, not solana.lend.positions' simple Earn positions.
function.name: solana__lend__borrowPositions

market.description: Which Borrow market: "main" or "ethena" (default "main"). An unrecognized value is rejected.

vaultIds.description: Comma-separated vault-id allow-list to filter positions to. Omit for all positions.

walletAddress.description: The wallet account to read, as a Solana address. Defaults to the session's selected Solana wallet.
